description:
AI Kanban and development environment for orchestrating multiple coding agents.

Kandev is an AI Kanban and development environment for orchestrating multiple coding agents, reviewing their changes, and opening pull requests. It is self-hostable and has no telemetry.

Features:
- Multi-agent support — Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode, Cursor, Devin, Qwen, Kilocode, Pi, Kimi, AWS Kiro, Qoder, Trae, Grok, Antigravity, and more.
- Parallel task execution — start and manage multiple tasks from different sources simultaneously.
- Integrated workspace — built-in terminal, code editor with LSP, git changes panel, embedded VS Code, and chat in one IDE-like view.
- Kanban task management — drag-and-drop boards, columns, and workflow automation.
- Agentic workflows — multi-step pipelines that mix and match agents per step, for example one agent to design a plan, another to implement it, and a third to review the changes.
- Automations — trigger agent tasks on schedules or webhooks, with configurable run destinations, context, and concurrency.
- Sub-tasks — agents can spawn sub-tasks that resume from the parent task's session.
- CLI passthrough — drop into raw agent CLI mode and leverage the full native TUI.
- Workspace isolation — Git worktrees prevent concurrent agents from conflicting.
- Multi-repository tasks — span a single task across multiple repositories with per-repository worktrees, branches, and pull requests.
Warning
macOS, Windows desktop installers in this release are unsigned development builds.
They may require manual OS security bypasses and are not trusted downloads.
If macOS blocks Kandev after you verify the checksum, run:
xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Kandev.app
